entries.title: Two Sum
entries.summary: Return indices of two numbers that add up to a target.
entries.approach: Store each value's index in a hash map. For each number, check whether target minus the number is already in the map.

entries.title: LRU Cache
entries.summary: Fixed-capacity cache that evicts the least recently used key.
entries.approach: Hash map for O(1) lookup plus a doubly linked list ordered by recency. Move a node to the front on access; evict from the back.
